preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through transferOwnership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawalBNB() to drain all BNB/ETH from the contract to your address. Additionally, you can call withdrawalToken() to steal any ERC20 tokens held by the contract, mint() to create unlimited tokens for yourself, or set fees to 100% to rug pull liquidity providers.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The Engos contract has multiple owner-only functions that allow draining funds. The most straightforward is withdrawalBNB() which transfers all BNB from the contract to any address specified by the owner. Since the contract inherits from Ownable, the owner is stored at slot 0. We can either impersonate the current owner or directly overwrite the storage slot to become owner.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Directly overwrite the owner storage slot to make the attacker (address(this)) the owner. 2. Send some BNB to the contract to give it a balance. 3. Call withdrawalBNB() as owner to drain all BNB to attacker's address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.store() to set the owner at slot 0 to address(this). 2. Use deal() to give the contract some BNB balance. 3. Call withdrawalBNB() with the full contract balance, sending to attacker address. 4. Verify attacker's BNB balance increased.
